 Will Junior Caminero become a household name for the Tampa Bay Rays in the ALCS? Nick Ziegler | Share on Facebook Share on X Add us as a preferred source Oct 7, 2026; Bronx, New York, USA; Tampa Bay Rays third baseman Junior Caminero (13) throws to first during the third inning against the New York Yankees in game three of the ALDS for the 2026 MLB Playoffs at Yankee Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Wendell Cruz-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect In this story:
 Tampa Bay Rays The Tampa Bay Rays now know who they will be facing in the American League Championship Series following the Cleveland Guardians pulling off a great come-from-behind series win over the Chicago White Sox. 
--> The Tampa Bay Rays now know who they will be facing in the American League Championship Series following the Cleveland Guardians pulling off a great come-from-behind series win over the Chicago White Sox. 
 With the final two teams set in the AL with a trip to the World Series on the line, this should be a fun series. Neither the Rays nor the Guardians are one of the big spenders in the majors, showcasing that perhaps all of this talk about a salary cap to promote balance is unnecessary. 
--> With the final two teams set in the AL with a trip to the World Series on the line, this should be a fun series. Neither the Rays nor the Guardians are one of the big spenders in the majors, showcasing that perhaps all of this talk about a salary cap to promote balance is unnecessary. 
 The two teams were able to get here in very different ways. The Guardians needed to come back from being down 2-0 in the ALDS against the White Sox, with both Game 3 and 4 being on the road. 
--> The two teams were able to get here in very different ways. The Guardians needed to come back from being down 2-0 in the ALDS against the White Sox, with both Game 3 and 4 being on the road. 
 For the Rays, they were able to sweep the New York Yankees in the ALDS and have created a ton of questions heading into the winter for their division rival. While it was certainly a group effort for Tampa Bay to get to where they are, one player who has helped lead them is Junior Caminero. Now, the young slugger has a chance to become a true star.

Mandatory Credit: Brad Penner-Imagn Images | IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect While the young third baseman of the Rays has started to put his name into the elite of the league, the ALCS will provide him with an opportunity on a national stage to become a household name. 
--> While the young third baseman of the Rays has started to put his name into the elite of the league, the ALCS will provide him with an opportunity on a national stage to become a household name. 
 More than likely, Caminero is going to end up being the runner-up to Yordan Alvarez in the AL MVP race. However, that shouldn’t take away from what he has been able to accomplish this season. The young slugger has put up MVP-caliber numbers and has been the best player on the best team in the league. 
--> More than likely, Caminero is going to end up being the runner-up to Yordan Alvarez in the AL MVP race. However, that shouldn’t take away from what he has been able to accomplish this season. The young slugger has put up MVP-caliber numbers and has been the best player on the best team in the league. 
 This season, he has slashed .276/.360/.524 with 42 home runs and 101 RBI. It was the second straight year in which he was able to total over 40 home runs and 100 RBI, while having a slugging percentage above .500.

 Caminero is certainly one of the brightest young stars in the game, but with a lack of national attention for Tampa Bay, he has flown under the radar. Against the Yankees, the Rays were able to make quick work of them to advance to the ALCS.

 Now, with all eyes on Tampa Bay against the Guardians, Caminero is going to get a chance to prove that he is one of the best young players in the league. The 23-year-old performed well against New York, but perhaps a signature moment will come in the ALCS.
